extracted text:
ITQ-17 were synthesized following literature procedures using tetraethyl ammonium (TEA+), 1-benzyl-4-aza-1-azoniacyclo[2,2,2]octane (BD+) and hexamethonium (HM2+) cations.

With TEAOH, a gel with the composition 0.666Si – 0.333Ge – 0.5TEAOH – 0.5HF – 7.5H2O was prepared and heated for 4 days at 140 °C under stirring (40 rpm).

The same gel composition was used to prepare a sample with BDOH: 0.666Si – 0.333Ge – 0.5BDOH – 0.5HF – 7.5H2O. The gel was autoclaved at 150 °C for 24 h under static conditions.

With HM(OH)2, a gel with the composition 0.833Si – 0.166Ge – 0.25HM(OH)2 – 2H2O was heated at 175 °C for 2 weeks under slow stirring (40 rpm).
